LESSON: FOOD AND FITNESS NUTRITION

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Foods and
Topic 3.3: Food and fitness Nutrition

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Food and fitness Nutrition. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why do we eat food?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. group foods into energy giving, body building and protective foods,
2. appreciate the importance of eating food from all the three food groups in a meal. of eating foods from all the three food groups in a meal devices of foods from the different classes and display in class devices on classifying foods into the three food groups the different classes of food using computing devices Core-Competence to be developed Self-efficacy, Digital literacy

1. group foods into energy giving, body building and protective foods,

Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Food and fitness Nutrition.
2. Explain Food and fitness Nutrition to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Food and fitness Nutrition.
4. Show that you can: group foods into energy giving, body building and protective foods,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Food and fitness Nutrition. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why do we eat food?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. group foods into energy giving, body building and protective foods,
2. appreciate the importance of eating food from all the three food groups in a meal. of eating foods from all the three food groups in a meal devices of foods from the different classes and display in class devices on classifying foods into the three food groups the different classes of food using computing devices Core-Competence to be developed Self-efficacy, Digital literacy
